description: This file defines the MenuProvider class, a ChangeNotifier that manages menu data (categories and items) in a restaurant app. It handles fetching data from an API or local cache and provides methods to access filtered menu items by category.

classes.name: MenuProvider
classes.description: A provider that manages menu categories and items, fetching data from API or cache, and notifying listeners on changes.

methods.name: MenuProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider and immediately refreshes menu data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches menu data from the API, falls back to cache if needed, and updates the provider state.

methods.name: itemsByCategory
methods.description: Returns available menu items filtered by category ID.
